about: County boundaries of the five New York City counties since 1898, from the Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries (New York), CC BY-NC-SA. Dates are those of each change in the Atlas; to=null means still in effect (the Atlas runs to 2000). Small change not drawn: Kings gained a small area from Queens, April 28, 1915 (N.Y. Laws 1915, ch. 410).

properties.name: Richmond
properties.change: RICHMOND created from Yorkshire, which had been organized in New York in 1664.

properties.name: Kings
properties.change: KINGS created from the shire of Yorkshire, which had been organized in 1664.

properties.name: Bronx
properties.change: BRONX gained small area from WESTCHESTER.

properties.name: Bronx
properties.change: BRONX gained South Brother Island from QUEENS.

properties.name: Queens
properties.change: QUEENS lost South Brother Island to BRONX.

properties.name: Queens
properties.change: QUEENS lost to SUFFOLK when town of Huntington gained Lloyd's Neck from town of Oyster Bay.

properties.name: Queens
properties.change: QUEENS lost to creation of NASSAU.

properties.name: New York
properties.change: NEW YORK lost to creation of BRONX.
